newsitem.title: FRANCE: French commission praises Alcatel's Thomson offer.
newsitem.headline: French commission praises Alcatel's Thomson offer.

text.p: France's privatisation commission praised an offer from Alcatel Alsthom to take over state electronics group Thomson SA.
The commission on Wednesday rejected the government's preference for an offer from Lagardere, forcing the government to suspend the privatisation.

"After examining the offer and complementary explanations supplied in hearings with Alcatel, the commission believes the industrial project has the double merit of being coherent and channeling the state's planned recapitalisation toward building a large European industrial concern with a global dimension," the report, which was obtained by Reuters, said.
